notes.title: Migration To Unity Engine Update!
notes.notes:
As you may know, this game was previously created using RPG Maker MZ. However, we started migrating the game to Unity Engine in April. Obviously, RPG Maker and Unity are very different, and we will undoubtedly face numerous challenges when rebuilding this game using the Unity engine.

But as you can see, it is definitely worth it to move to unity!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659562/30c8097cbc7cc4882e1c7deae17d61d243735b47.png[/img]

First, I'd want to demonstrate the difference between RPG Maker MZ Renderer and Unity Engine Renderer. The Unity version is more clearer and has smoother animation than RPG Maker MZ.

While we are not able to recreate 100% of the features on the RPG Maker MZ, we are able to replicate almost all of the features from the previous engine to the new one, and even improve on it!

Today, we'd like to share some screenshots from the Unity Engine-powered game.

notes.title: Announcing Remastered Version of Previous version of Insurgence
notes.notes:
Platomenti Studios and YSY Softworks partnered with CRX Entertainment Pte Ltd are pleased to announce the upcoming release of the Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault.

The Remastered version of these two games is set to feature a brand new pixel rendering engine, providing players with even more vibrant and rich colors than ever before, bringing these games to life in a whole new way. In addition, the games will be localized to more languages, with more details on which languages to come soon.

For Insurgence - Chains of Renegade, the game will also feature all new music from SSCore, a music production studio from YSY Softworks. This in-house music production studio has collaborated with Platomenti Studios for this release, providing an entirely new soundtrack for players to enjoy as they progress through the game.

"We're thrilled to bring these two beloved games back to the forefront with the Remastered version," said a spokesperson for Platomenti Studios. "With the new pixel rendering engine and the addition of more languages, we're confident that players will love the new look and feel of the game. And with the all-new music from SSCore, we're confident that both new and returning players will have an unforgettable experience."

The Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault will be available on PC, with a Steam release planned for the near future. The Steam page is now up for Wishlist, so fans of the series can show their support and stay up-to-date with the latest news on the upcoming release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327370/Insurgence__Chains_of_Renegade_Remastered/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327380/Insurgence__Second_Assault_Remastered/


For more information on the Remastered version of Insurgence - Chains of Renegade and Insurgence - Second Assault, please visit the official website of Platomenti Studios or follow their social media pages.

notes.title: System Requirements Update & Lite Version Announced
notes.notes:
Hello, based on current CBT run, especially on Batch 4 and Batch 5 testing, We decide to update the Minimum and Reccomended specification for the game, due to report of the game slowdown and lag even on an system supposedly can run the game.

Minimum System Requirements now.

[list]
[*] CPU: [b]AMD Athlon 200GE[/b] (Before [i]AMD A8 5550M APU[/i]) or [b]Intel Core i3-6100[/b] (Before [i]Intel Core i3-4010U[/i])

[*] Ram: 4 GB (Before [i]3 GB[/i])

[*] GPU: [b]AMD Radeon Vega 3[/b] (Before AMD Radeon HD 7550M) or [b]Intel HD 530[/b] (Before [i]Intel HD 4400[/i]) or [b]Nvidia GT 730[/b] (Before [i]Nvidia GT 710[/i])

[*] The rest is same (eg. Windows, HDD Space etc.)
[/list]

Reccomended System Requirements now.

[list]
[*] CPU: [b]AMD Ryzen 3 3200G[/b] (Before [i]AMD A10 9600P APU[/i]) or [b]Intel Core i3-10100[/b] (Before [i]i3 5010U[/i])

[*] GPU: [b]AMD Radeon Vega 8[/b] (Before [i]AMD Radeon R5 Graphics[/i]) or [b]Intel UHD 630[/b] (Before [i]Intel HD 5500[/i]) or [b]Nvidia GT 1030[/b] (Before Nvidia GT 730)

[*] The rest is same (eg. Windows, HDD Space etc.)
[/list]

Due to rising System Requirements, we will also gonna ship the Lite Version at launch, Lite Version is the lighter version of the game that supposedly can run on lower end PC and set top box computer.

We will put the Lite Version as Free DLC or Installing it via Beta Build (depending on which one is easier for the player) and based on internal testing at YSY Softworks test lab, the Lite version can run on a system as low as 2nd Gen Mobile Core i3 with onboard Intel HD 3000 GPU.

System Requirements for the [i]Lite Version[/i]

[list]
[*] CPU: AMD A4 5000 APU or Intel Core i3-2350M
[*] Ram: 3GB Ram
[*] GPU: AMD Radeon HD 6450 / Intel HD 3000 / Nvidia GT 430
[/list]
[i]
What's the difference between Regular and Lite? Why the system requirements for the Lite is very low compared to the Regular?[/i]

Regular version is using component known as PixiJS and Pixi Filter, while making the art and the colors more pop but the graphical improvement causing huge impact on the system.

While player can disabling the eye candy effect by change the graphics setting to "Low" and at low setting actually many PC even below the system requirements can run, but still on some older computer or lower end celeron some lag and hiccup occurs.

On the Lite version we not only disabling the PixiJS and Filter, we also disabling some of the animation, motion and extra effect. Making the game may look bit "generic" but should be playable 24+ fps even on 11 yrs old Laptop with Intel HD 3000 and Second gen Intel Core i3.
